finalText:
Build passes now, 0 errors.

Two real bugs were hiding under all those deprecation warnings, both from the bundler bump changing shapes it hands to your code:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. That crashed the build outright.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing backoff flag as an error, but the new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed it to treat unset the same as off.

The leftover deprecation warnings (`Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, `punycode`, etc.) are just noise from the bump, not breakage, so I left them alone. Build finishes clean with exit 0.
